facts.fact: The Minister of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations promised to improve accessibility on all government digital platforms by following standards such as WCAG.
The NCA said it is designing, with device makers and dealers, a new minimum specification for terminal devices for Ghana by 2026 that requires an accessibility feature before type approval.
